re.service: Genetic expression profiling test for breast cancer (CPT 81519)

title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Riverside Orthopedic Associates under your Medicaid managed care plan for services provided on August 17, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Reason for denial: The genetic expression profiling test for breast cancer is considered experimental or investigational for your condition under our medical policy. Reason code: CO-55.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $4,486.99 billed. The provider may bill you for this service.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Hollis Creek Health, Appeals Unit, PO Box 4137, Columbus, OH 43215. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-5026.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
